# opencode-limits-go [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/cusvv/opencode-limits-go?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/cusvv/opencode-limits-go/releases/latest) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/cusvv/opencode-limits-go/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square&label=CI)](https://github.com/cusvv/opencode-limits-go/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/opencode-limits-go?style=flat-square)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-limits-go) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![OpenCode](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenCode-v2.3%2B-111827?style=flat-square)](https://opencode.ai) [![Language](https://img.shields.io/badge/Lang-EN%20%7C%20RU-16a34a?style=flat-square)](#features) **OpenCode Go** quota monitor plugin for **OpenCode v2.3+** (TUI & Desktop GUI). Displays live usage across all three OpenCode Go windows — **5-hour rolling**, **weekly**, and **monthly** — with threshold alerts, flexible placement in Desktop GUI, automatic English/Russian localization matching your OpenCode UI language, and built-in GitHub auto-updates. --- ## Screenshots

More screenshots: Settings dialog & Terminal TUI

--- ## Features - **All OpenCode Go windows**: `5h` / `1w` / `1m` percentages, reset timestamps, countdowns, elapsed-time markers (`|`), recent `~1h` deltas, and tightest-window summary. - **Smart pace estimation v2**: Combines window-average and local snapshot history to suppress tiny spikes while catching fresh coding bursts across `5h`, `1w`, and `1m`. - **OpenCode Zen & today's activity**: Displays active Console budgets (`$spent / $limit`) and today's local `opencode-go` tokens vs. `opencode` (Zen) USD spend inside the dialog and hover tooltip. - **Works with any OpenCode auth setup**: - OpenCode Console **OAuth** account (`opencode`) - Saved **API key** (`opencode-go` or `opencode` integration) - Environment variables (`OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`, `OPENCODE_API_KEY`, `OPENCODE_ZEN_API_KEY`) - Plugin options or provider settings in `opencode.json` - Lazy fallback to `opencode auth export` and legacy `~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json` - **Desktop GUI**: - Clickable status strip with color-coded or monochrome progress bars and `⚡` fast-burn indicators - **Quick OpenCode Console access**: Direct button in the limits dialog and Settings page to open your org's Console usage page - **Settings window** (`/limits-settings`, gear button in the limits dialog, and native `Settings → OpenCode Go limits`) with a live strip preview and 1-click presets (`Standard`, `Only 5h`, `Text`, `Minimal`) - **Placement options**: Bottom bar (default), Top bar (`session.header`), Both, Titlebar / sidebar button, or Hidden - **Custom strip layout & behavior**: Show/hide individual windows (`5h`, `1w`, `1m`), switch indicator style (`Bar + %`, `Text only`, `Bars only`), toggle window labels, customize warning thresholds (`70%` / `80%` / `90%` / `100% only`) and refresh intervals (`30s` / `90s` / `5m`) - Instant activity updates on model turns and window focus - Light & dark theme support - **TUI**: - Live sidebar indicator (`sidebar.content`) with semantic theme colors, optional mini-bars, and `⚡` burn indicator - `/limits` popup with Go windows, smart pace, `+1h` delta, and today's Go/Zen usage - `/limits-settings` & `/limits-windows` interactive selectors (toggle bars, window filter, thresholds, update check) - Command palette entries and `Ctrl+Shift+L` shortcut; auto-refreshes on `session.usage.updated`, periodically, and on credential changes - **Bilingual (English / Russian)**: Automatically follows the OpenCode UI language (Desktop `ctx.locale`, or `OPENCODE_LANG` / `LC_ALL` / `LANG` in TUI). - **Auto-Update**: Checks [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/cusvv/opencode-limits-go/releases) for new versions and automatically installs updates in the background (can be toggled or triggered manually in Settings). - **Security-first**: Tokens never leave the server process — never sent over RPC, never shown in the UI, and automatically redacted from logs (`%TEMP%/opencode-limits-go.log` or `/tmp/opencode-limits-go.log`). --- ## Installation Requires **OpenCode v2.3.0+** and an active OpenCode Go credential (via `opencode auth login` or `OPENCODE_API_KEY`). ### Option 1: Quick Install via OpenCode CLI (recommended) ```sh opencode plugin add opencode-limits-go # or directly from GitHub: opencode plugin add github:cusvv/opencode-limits-go ``` Then restart **OpenCode Desktop** (or run `/reload` in open TUI sessions). ### Option 2: Clone with Git ```sh # macOS / Linux git clone https://github.com/cusvv/opencode-limits-go.git ~/.config/opencode/local-plugins/opencode-limits-go ``` ```powershell # Windows (PowerShell) git clone https://github.com/cusvv/opencode-limits-go.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.config\opencode\local-plugins\opencode-limits-go" ``` ### Option 3: Download Release Archive Download `opencode-limits-go.zip` or `opencode-limits-go.tar.gz` from the [Releases](https://github.com/cusvv/opencode-limits-go/releases) page and extract it so the folder is: - Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.config\opencode\local-plugins\opencode-limits-go` - macOS / Linux: `~/.config/opencode/local-plugins/opencode-limits-go` ### Enable in `opencode.json` (Options 2 & 3) For manual installs, add `./local-plugins/opencode-limits-go` to `plugins` in your global `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`: ```jsonc { "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json", "plugins": [ "./local-plugins/opencode-limits-go" ] } ``` > **Optional:** You can also pass an API token directly via plugin options: > ```jsonc > { > "plugins": [ > { > "package": "./local-plugins/opencode-limits-go", > "options": { "token": "{env:OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY}" } > } > ] > } > ``` Restart **OpenCode Desktop** (and run `/reload` in open TUI sessions). No `npm install` is required — `dist/gui-experimental.cjs` is prebuilt. --- ## Usage & Shortcuts | Action | Shortcut / Command | |---|---| | Show limits dialog | `/limits` or `Ctrl+Shift+L` (or click the indicator in Desktop) | | Open plugin settings (Desktop & TUI) | `/limits-settings`, gear button in dialog, or `Settings → OpenCode Go limits` | | Filter TUI sidebar windows | `/limits-windows` | ### Verify via CLI ```sh opencode plugin list opencode api post /api/rpc/opencode-limits-go/status --data '{"input":{"force":true}}' ``` --- ## Development ```sh npm install npm test # Run unit tests (model, auth, updater) npm run build # Typecheck server/TUI/GUI and rebuild dist/gui-experimental.cjs ``` ### Project Structure ``` src/ index.ts Server plugin: RPC endpoints, caching, event invalidation, auto-updater loop auth.ts Multi-source credential discovery & deduplication api.ts OpenCode Go usage HTTP client model.ts Pure formatting, validation, EN/RU localization, semver, secret redaction updater.ts GitHub Releases updater with HTTPS allowlist & staged verification rpc.ts Portable RPC contract log.ts Rotating JSON logger (256 KB max) tui.tsx OpenTUI adapter gui.tsx Desktop GUI adapter (SolidJS + OpenCode GUI SDK) dist/ gui-experimental.cjs Prebuilt CommonJS Desktop GUI bundle ``` --- ## License [MIT](LICENSE)
